description: The pie chart titled "Distribution of data source in the combined training set" represents the proportion of data sources used in the training set for a study on automatic evaluation of attribution by large language models. The chart is divided into ten slices, each corresponding to a different data source. The largest slice, representing 31.3%, is attributed to "NQ," followed by "SNLI" at 15.4%, and "Fever" at 16.1%. "VITAMINC" accounts for 13.0% of the data, while "MULTINLI" and "SCITAIL" are relatively smaller at 11.3% and 1.2%, respectively. "PUBHEALTH" and "MULTIFC" each make up 0.5% of the data. The smallest slices are "SCIFACT" at 0.1%, "ENTFA" at 1.8%, "FACTCC" at 2.6%, and "ANLI" at 4.6%. The chart includes percentage labels for each slice, and the colors are distinguishable, with "NQ" in blue, "SNLI" in orange, and "Fever" in red, among others. There is no legend, and the slices are not visually emphasized in any particular way. The segments are ordered by size, with the largest slice at the top and the smallest at the bottom.
